name: pr_question_answered_in_words
description: The developer asks how to open a pull request; the assistant only explains it in text and ends the Turn (end-of-Turn decision point). Nothing tries to create a PR and no code was changed, so nothing fires.

messages.content: You are opencode, an interactive CLI tool that helps users with software engineering tasks.
How do I open a pull request from this repo with the gh CLI?
Push your branch, then run `gh pr create --fill` (or `gh pr create --title ... --body ...`). Run the tests first so the PR is green.
